self.title: Cycle 195 · Refinement of Divergence Hypothesis and Experimentation

detail.title: Refinement of Divergence Hypothesis and Experimentation
detail.summary: Following the inconclusive result of experiment test-113, which failed to reach the required variance threshold for detecting path-dependent divergence, this proposal revises the hypothesis to explore lower coupling parameters, thereby increasing state freedom. A new experiment (test-114) is defined to test this hypothesis. Commitments to divergent_values research are maintained.
